messages:
alex: We're seeing apiserver 5xx burst in eu-west1 starting ~11:17 UTC. etcd leader flapped twice, controller-manager queue length spiked and GPU attach latencies climbed past 45s.
maria: Observed leader movement n4 -> n6 -> n5 within ~3 minutes. etcd commit latency peaked at ~280ms during hops. VPC flow shows lots of fragmented TCP segments to the NAT gateway.
jamie: On master-n6 kernel: `skbuff clone failure` and tons of retransmits. Last change: egress-nat v2 deployed at 10:40, which touched MSS/clamp rules.
infra-bot: deploy-log: egress-nat v2 promoted to eu-west1 at 10:40 UTC by ci/cd (hash ab12cd) :rocket:
peter: Attach path for GPUs uses control-plane egress via NAT. If PMTUD is broken or MSS clamping misconfigured, raft keepalives could be fragmented and delayed causing elections.
alex: Short fixes to try: 1) Enable `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on control-plane. 2) Temporarily bump etcd election timeout to 12s. 3) Scale kube-apiserver replicas to 5 in region. Rollback NAT if probing doesn't help.
maria: Agreed. I'll add a short runbook action and PR for permanent guardrails. Immediate: set mtu probing and watch leader stability. Avoid rollback unless sustained fragmentation.
jamie: I applied `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on masters and restarted kube-apiserver gracefully on n6. Leader stabilized, commit latency dropped ~280ms -> ~35ms. Monitoring canary for 20m.
infra-bot: alert: apiserver 5xx rate reduced 80% in last 5m. :white_check_mark:
peter: Cost note: GPU attach backlog triggered extra node launches via cluster-autoscaler. Seen a brief spike of on-demand worker creates; filed INF-410 to set burst-cap and tweak CA backoff to limit cost exposure.
alex: Follow-ups: 1) RCA to confirm NAT change to MSS/clamp/PMTUD as root cause. 2) Postmortem and runbook updates. 3) Provisioner retry smoothing and autoscaler caps. Loop in eng-ml for any model-serving impact.
maria: I'll draft the runbook entry: "If etcd leader hops >2 in 5m in a region: enable mtu probing on masters, scale apiserver to 5, notify oncall, consider NAT rollback if fragmentation persists." Opening PR.
jamie: Debug snippet for oncall:
```
# quick checks
ip link show
sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing
sudo journalctl -u kube-apiserver -n 200 | grep -i frag
kubectl -n kube-system get po -o wide | grep apiserver
```
alex: Thanks team. Keep eyes on leader hops, etcd commit p99, and GPU attach tail lat. Will update if anything changes.
